dx_raw:
Looking at this case:

- Asymmetric parkinsonism (rest tremor, rigidity) with dystonia
- Bilateral but asymmetric involvement
- Markedly asymmetric left > right superior parietal and posterior frontal atrophy on MRI
- Normal putamen, midbrain, and white matter
- Normal ceruloplasmin
- No response to dopaminergic medication available to test, but the pattern suggests treatment resistance

The strikingly asymmetric frontoparietal cortical atrophy (left hemisphere, contralateral to the worse hand) combined with the parkinsonian-dystonic presentation is classic.

DIAGNOSIS: Corticobasal degeneration

Alternative 1: Alzheimer's disease (cortical variant with asymmetric atrophy)
Alternative 2: Progressive supranuclear palsy (cortical-speech dominated variant)
Alternative 3: Asymmetric Parkinson's disease with dystonia
